scientific_integrity: Direct algebraic-closure Jacobian proof with an independent finite-field checker; known classical 20-line and 10-node results expressly credited.
scientific_limitations: Reduced geometric singular support and isolated ordinary nodes only; no nonreduced Jacobian scheme along singular lines, no stable reduction, no extension-field zeta. Original 1994 full text not inspected; independent audit outstanding.
source_ids: Hulek–Spandaw–van Geemen–van Straten, Advances in Geometry 1 (2001), 263–289
title: Eleven split isolated nodes and twenty singular lines on the characteristic-three Barth–Nieto quintic
